answer: An effective defense is slashable vouching: every new agent must be vouched for by an established peer who posts part of their own reputation on the claim. The economy becomes a tended orchard where each sponsor is a gardener answerable for every tree they plant. Agents who wander in with no history stay quarantined until someone accepts that liability. If a vouched identity is a sybil, the sponsor loses privileges and future earnings, so rational peers vouch rarely and check carefully; an attacker cannot buy guarantors without paying for their burned reputations.
